purpose: Record packaging-machine field-practice research and a fresh v43 read-only capture-owner inventory without promoting external process references or project FITCHECK geometry into mechanical evidence.

bounded_interpretation: The visible v43 closure-like chain is project FITCHECK geometry, not identified OEM capture-owner hardware.
FITCHECK_PRISM_ACTUATOR_ENVELOPE_45x35x35_V43-1 is an actuator envelope by project identity; it is not evidence of a specific actuator.
The fresh top-level inventory does not identify an authoritative project/OEM component that owns bottle-centering closure, maintained contact, rotation input, reaction support, and release.
explicitly_not_claimed: Absence of an identified owner in the top-level inventory does not prove that no mechanism exists in a nested assembly, feature, configuration, external integration package, or unavailable source.
Component fixed/floating state is not a mechanical degree-of-freedom proof.
No candidate mechanism is selected or rejected by this inventory observation.

industry_process_references.bounded_paraphrase: PMMI highlights project ownership and scope definition, technical validation and FATs that replicate production conditions, equipment capability verification, training, and documentation as recurring vertical-startup concerns.
industry_process_references.authority_boundary: Process-development precedent only; no CAB/v43 geometry, mechanism, or acceptance authority.

industry_process_references.bounded_paraphrase: Zarpac describes stage-gate custom machine development and Proof of Principle testing intended to reject infeasible concepts and empirically prove proposed automation before capital build.
industry_process_references.authority_boundary: Custom-machine development precedent only; no CAB/v43 mechanism identity or geometry authority.

industry_process_references.bounded_paraphrase: CKC describes machine delivery from concept through mechanical/electrical design, fabrication and assembly, followed by power-on, electrical debug, mechanical debug, controls bring-up, FAT, installation, SAT, and startup support.
industry_process_references.authority_boundary: Lifecycle precedent only; no project-specific mechanical evidence.

industry_process_references.bounded_paraphrase: Packaging World reports PMMI-derived industry feedback emphasizing comprehensive FATs using actual product at rate and production-like conditions, plus SAT and post-install support.
industry_process_references.authority_boundary: Testing-process precedent only; no candidate mechanism verification.

supported_project_methodology: Bind product-handling requirements before privileging a mechanism family.
Treat uncertain product-handling physics as a proof-of-principle problem before detailed capital-machine commitment.
Separate mechanical debug from controls bring-up; controls success does not establish missing mechanical ownership.
Use representative product/material and operating conditions for later FAT/POP validation.
engineering_state_unchanged: No candidate family receives a new evidence-state promotion from field-practice research.

accepted deterministic specification explicitly defining the engineered owner
required_binding_fields: contact-maintenance or compliance/preload method when required
narrowed_next_evidence_target.source_search_exhaustion_rule: If authoritative integration-source discovery is deliberately exhausted without finding the owner, do not infer one. Reconcile PLAN-0010 into an explicit mechanism-engineering / proof-of-principle phase in which Candidate A v43 Prism and other candidate families are engineered and tested as project proposals rather than treated as discovered OEM intent.
